summary: Iteration 2 — validation of Export (PDF/DOCX), status-change notifications (simulation), and dark-mode toggle. Backend: 25/25 pytest tests pass, including 4 new export tests (auth required, PDF magic bytes %PDF, DOCX zip PK header, cross-user 404) and 1 notification-flow test (submit-documents + writer/update-status). Simulation email logs confirmed: '[email:simulation] to=... subject=... (RESEND_API_KEY absent)' emitted for both client and writer on each transition. Frontend Playwright: theme-toggle present on /, /editeur, /client, /redacteur; dark class toggles on <html>, persists in localStorage 'mp_theme' after reload. Editor Export PDF and Export Word both trigger real downloads (TEST_Export_M_moire.pdf / .docx). Admin login flows straight into /redacteur with 10 order-cards auto-loaded (previous iteration's admin-needs-key gap is FIXED). No critical bugs.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 767 lines — past the 700-line split threshold. Recommend splitting into routers/ (auth, orders, writer, documents, ai, export) and services/ (email, export_builder) before next feature iteration.
_build_docx / _build_pdf are CPU-bound and called on the async request thread. Under load this will block the event loop; consider await asyncio.to_thread(_build_pdf, ...).

notify_status_change / notify_documents_submitted are dispatched via asyncio.create_task without a handled exception path — errors will only surface via logs. Wrap the task in try/except to avoid 'Task exception was never retrieved' warnings when Resend is later enabled.
Export endpoint accepts any string as ?format — anything other than 'docx' silently returns PDF. Consider validating with a Literal['pdf','docx'] to return 400 on unknown formats.

Filename sanitizer _safe_filename converts accented characters to '_' (e.g., 'Mémoire' → 'M_moire'). Non-blocking but slightly ugly; consider unicodedata.normalize NFKD ASCII fold or keep unicode inside RFC 5987 filename*=UTF-8'' header.
